readerContract.humanQuestion: Who is this woman or cultural guide, why is she in this wing, and what useful AI lesson should I remember?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Each card gives one bounded fact or clearly labelled cultural interpretation, one practical lesson, and a trustworthy route to continue.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: The reader may recognize some names but is not expected to know computing history, current AI organizations, or LAiDIES' teaching roles.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: The three wings do different jobs: SAiNTS make habits memorable, MAiVENS show the lineage and critique of computing, and TRAiLBLAZERS show current practice.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: The lesson on each card should change one ordinary choice: define the job, test the evidence, choose a tool, protect private information, or ask a better question.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A compact, source-linked profile archive that remains enjoyable to browse and does not turn into a biography wall.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: Oriented, interested, and capable of explaining why each guide belongs without being asked to worship a greatest-women canon.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: A source correction, current-role change, link failure, roster decision, or lesson-role change.

strengthsToUse: Answer why the person matters before adding detail.
Separate supported fact, LAiDIES interpretation, and freshness limits.
Turn evidence into a practical reader move and an exact continuation link.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not repeat the same answer scaffold word-for-word across 43 cards.
Do not inherit any of the exemplar's dated claims or long-form section lengths.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Use one plain lesson per card and define a technical term only where it performs that lesson.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The card schema has no glossary field and caps the fact and lesson at one short paragraph each.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Keep the information architecture stable but vary sentence construction according to the actual work.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: Role, fact, lesson, freshness, and links have separate fields rather than a repeated prose formula.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: Use no analogy unless it precisely explains the person's contribution.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The profile plan uses direct explanations and no analogy field.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: Every named work or institution must link to the source that supports that exact card.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: The source packet maps every Maven and Trailblazer to a claim-specific source.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: State the contribution in cause-and-effect language where a mechanism is required.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: Lessons explain what changes in search, data, privacy, interfaces, deployment, or model behaviour.

genericAction.producerGuard: Make each lesson a distinct choice the reader can recognize or use.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The locked Saint roles and each Maven/Trailblazer interpretation have a unique reader job.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Put ordinary meaning before terms such as compiler, differential privacy, or probabilistic model.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: Each technical term is paired with what it lets people or systems do.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Explain the three wing jobs at the archive level and the person-specific job on each card.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: Wing introduction plus role/fact/lesson fields preserve the relationship between person and archive.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Keep the Saint teaching device playful while treating real women's work with adult warmth and specificity.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: Visual wings carry the delight; factual cards avoid flat encyclopedia prose and forced jokes.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: Connect each profile to durable judgment, not one prompt trick.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: Lessons cover evidence, privacy, uncertainty, systems, teaching, and deployment choices.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Lead each wing with why a visitor would use it.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: The archive introduction states the three reader jobs before the technical contributions.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Treat every profile as one lens within a larger lineage, not a complete history.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: The page explicitly rejects greatest-women ranking and preserves three collections.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Use capable-adult plain language and short sentences.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: Card copy avoids insider abbreviations unless the source work requires and explains them.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Every card answers who she is, what she changed or represents, what LAiDIES learns from it, and where to continue.
causalSequence: A visitor first sees the wing and the person's distinct role.
A bounded factual sentence or labelled cultural interpretation explains why she belongs.
A practical lesson translates that reason into a useful judgment or habit.
A source, work, social, or song link lets the visitor continue without trusting the card alone.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Karen Spärck Jones: Cambridge-supported information-retrieval work becomes the plain lesson that search weighs what distinguishes a term, not just whether it appears.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: Amanda Askell: a current first-party Constitution source becomes the lesson that model behaviour is designed through explicit values and revisions.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Choose one guide, read the evidence boundary, and follow the exact source or song rather than treating the portrait as proof.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Wing job; portrait card; name and role; one bounded fact or interpretation; one LAiDIES lesson; freshness label where volatile; exact continuation links; optional local pick.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Do not add invented quotations, generic struggle paragraphs, ranking language, or decorative objects to make every profile look equally dramatic.

humourPlan.lessonJob: The playful Saint titles make habits memorable; no jokes are added to historical erasure, living-person role claims, or source limits.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: A reference card has room for one visible mechanism and one useful landing, not a full lecture arc.

humanQuestion.reason: The visitor needs to know why this person belongs and what to do with the lesson.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Role and lesson appear before continuation links.

usefulCuriosity.reason: A surprising contribution can invite the reader into primary evidence.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Each Maven fact names one concrete contribution without inflated first claims.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: Several contributions concern hidden software, statistical, privacy, or organizational systems.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: The lesson states the visible effect of the underlying work in plain language.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: Readers need movement from an ordinary decision to the technical contribution.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Each lesson links the person's work to search, instructions, data, privacy, interfaces, or deployment.

limitationsConsequences.reason: Historical priority and current-role claims are easy to overstate.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: The source packet and cards avoid absolute firsts and date volatile roles.

humourSurprise.reason: The Saint wing uses playful archetypes to make the learning move memorable.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Humour remains in titles and songs, not unsupported biography.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The archive should produce a useful follow-on question, not passive admiration.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: Every card ends with an evidence or work route and a distinct practical lesson.

explanationArc.adaptation: Each card compresses the arc into role, fact, lesson, and source; the wing introduction carries the shared starting point.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: Profiles could repeat stale current roles, inflated first claims, or attractive but source-free interpretations.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Validate this contract, bind exact card text to the source packet, run maker self-review, then require a role-distinct artifact-first factual and visual review.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A reader can distinguish sourced fact from LAiDIES interpretation and explain one useful reason each selected guide belongs.
